messages:
nora: FYI vendor pen test locked for Jun 9-10. Need a clear RBAC plan, KMS handoff rules, and retest slots.
kevin: Suggest 36h timeboxed role 'pt_vendor' issued by IDP after ops+sec approval. No kms:Decrypt allowed for role. All decrypts via a sealed service.
sasha: I'll build the sealed-service. It will accept a wrapped key, decrypt in-memory in an HSM-backed task, produce the artifact, upload to a locked S3 prefix, then shred plaintext. Audit entries for each step.
ops-bot: NOTE: Block deployments Jun 8-11 unless exempted. React :white_check_mark: to acknowledge.
kevin: Evidence bundle should include last 5 days of app logs, full infra logs for the window, DB schema dump, and authz traces with token markers.
nora: Legal reminder: get DPA signed before releasing any bundle that contains secrets.
sasha: Implementation detail: use envelope encryption; if customer KMS key provided we will use it and log key-id. Manifest will include filename, sha256, key_id, and creation_ts.
kevin: Presign automation example for runbook:
aws s3 presign s3://pt-handoffs/4365011111/bundle.tar.gz --expires-in 129600
nora: Triage/retet plan: label findings, assign owner in tracker, estimate fix + verification, schedule two retest slots within 10 days after fix. High severity gets immediate hotfix slot.
sasha: Also adding deploy calendar gate: IDP will not issue roles if a critical migration is scheduled in the window.
legal: Will circulate DPA template today. Confirming assessor is third-party processor until DPA signed.
kevin: Action items: Sasha -> sealed-service + audit rows (due 2026-05-20). Nora -> runbook + approval flow (due 2026-05-12). Legal -> DPA (due 2026-05-05).
nora: I'll run a dry run one week prior and post the sample bundle link. Thanks team.
